_source: Reflection's reply on PR #229 at head 0c8a6ccc (review 5998648415, 2026-11-20): the summary and findings it posted. The comment read 'No findings' while the summary named three concerns.

reply.summary: The change adds withheld churn scoring on filled model inputs, clears both probability and risk level for unscored customers, and propagates clear outcomes through the closed loop and Monday reporting. The main enterprise-readiness concerns are around incomplete CRM-clear reporting, a potential release of churn scores for filled inputs, and compatibility of persisted closed-loop rows.
